alyssa: Quick sync: follow-up on the regional fanout + DNS TTL race we saw earlier. putting owners and short ETAs here.

ben: ack. quick LC summary?

alyssa: tl;dr: control-plane route update retried on transient DB lock -> returned 500 to callers. clients dropped to resolver cache which had older region priorities. coupled with a recent LB affinity change, that produced simultaneous cross-region retries and a short TLS handshake surge.

megan: got it. is this primarily a control-plane bug or client-side backoff issue?

raj: root cause is control-plane DB contention + absence of server-side circuit-breaker. client backoff worsened the spike but doesn't cause TTL divergence. also saw some edges honoring stale registrar TTL for ~90s.

simon: i'll own LB mitigations (canary limits + rollback knobs). plan: add per-route burst cap and a health gate to prevent immediate multi-region failover. ETA: 24h for canary + rollback doc.

ben: i own the control-plane fix: add DB retry with jitter + 503 fallback + circuit-breaker to avoid cascading 500s. ETA: 48h for patch, 72h for rollout. PR when ready.

lina: i'll take registrar follow-up and edge cache TTL alignment. opening ticket with registrar and edge-team. ETA: ticket + contact info by EOD.

raj: telemetry & alerts: creating two alerts now:
- digital: route-update-500-rate > 0.2% over 5m => Pager
- cross_region_retry_ratio > 8% over 3m => SRE page
Dash link: https://console.redwood/intern/dash/2778001112
ETA: 3h for alerts + dashboard panels.

alyssa: Action items (compact):
1) ben 12 control-plane circuit-breaker + retry policy (48h)
2) simon 12 LB per-route burst cap + rollback playbook (24h)
3) raj 12 telemetry + alerts + dashboard (3h)
4) lina 12 registrar ticket + edge TTL alignment (EOD)
5) megan 12 testbed replay + synthetic probe for 500->resolver fallback (start in 48h, run 72h)

ben: WIP branch: github.com/redwood/control-plane/compare/cb-retries-2778. logs: s3://redwood-incidents/2778001112/logs.tar.gz

megan: creating synthetic agent job to simulate route-update 500 and varying TTLs. will include TLS handshake rate metric. job id: syn-33221. ETA queue: tomorrow AM.

simon: sample LB config to cap cross-region bursts:
```json
{"max_cross_region_burst":60,"enable_health_gate":true,"rollback_tag":"fanout-2778"}
```
PR: github.com/redwood/lb/pull/2001 (canary only).

lina: registrar ticket #RG-12111 opened. added edge-team owners. notes: registrar caches sometimes ignore sub-minute TTL; asking for explicit support for 30s TTL.

raj: added a short playbook for ops-runbook: if route-update 5xx surge occurs, toggle lb canary, enable rollback_tag, and pause client-stats refresh for 2m. pushing to docs repo.

alyssa: schedule: weekly follow-up for 4 weeks to track recurrence + regression tests. @sre-bot please schedule starting next Monday 09:00 UTC.
